_comment: Pipeline knobs. Edit and the next run picks it up. The chat agent's update_config tool (Layer 9) writes here too.

quota._one_per_company_title: true = at most one queue slot per company per title per day: the highest-scored instance queues, the others stay 'discovered' (eligible another day) and are logged as queue_dedupe
quota._daily_max_note: the through-the-day loop (topup.py) can only auto-apply to jobs that get queued; at 10 the morning run fills the day's queue and later cycles find little new. Raise toward 25-35 to feed the loop more supply — but each queued ats/direct job writes a ~$0.015 letter and scoring costs too, so this spends more against cost.monthly_cap_usd. Your call.

cost._note: hard monthly API budget. topup.py stops paid discovery (scoring + letters) once month-to-date spend reaches monthly_cap_usd - topup_headroom_usd; the free submission step (probe + Playwright fill, no API) still runs so queued jobs keep applying. Does NOT gate the 6 AM discovery — that is bounded by quota.daily_max.

letters._note: max_per_run x ~$0.015 per letter is the daily letter budget
letters._windows: cross_window: soft sameness checks vs the last N letters; context_lines: recent letters shown to the model; hook_window/hook_avoid_fraction: a material used in more than that share of the last N letters is avoided; hard_echo_days: the hard echo check covers every letter written within N days
letters._soft_rewrites: 1 = a draft with only soft warnings gets one rewrite (~+$0.015 on flagged letters); 0 = log and keep

submission._dry_run: true = every path only LOGS what it would do. Nothing calls Jobright, nothing becomes status=applied. Flip to false only after the intended-action log has been reviewed.
submission._verify_first_n: handoff form records captured while the head is inside its first N live sends (state.json auto_submit.live_count, submit_click only). Set 0 to turn the window off.
submission._max_per_run: jobs the submission stage processes per run. Probing/routing is free and only 'ready' jobs launch a browser, so raising this is cheap — but at a low value, gated high-score jobs (a code challenge, a rendered CAPTCHA) can consume the budget before the loop reaches lower-scored auto-applyable ones. The ramp still caps real sends at 1/run through send #20.

auto_submit._daily_target: topup.py aims to reach daily_target hands-off auto-applies/day and stops finding new jobs once daily_max is reached. These are ceilings and aspirations, not guarantees: the loop can only apply to ungated, account-free jobs that exist and are queued that day, which is often fewer than the target. It never pads and never double-applies.
auto_submit._note: the autonomous ATS head (autosubmit.py). enabled=false (the shipped default): never launches a browser, the 08:00 batch hands off exactly as before. dry_run=true: fills the real form, screenshots it to screenshots/<day>/<id>-filled.png, never clicks submit, then hands off as before. Live: the first verify_first_n sends screenshot form + confirmation for the nightly report — verification, not a gate. Counter: state.json auto_submit.live_count. Only an explicit exact-option answer-file match fills a dropdown; export controls / citizenship / clearance never inferred. Raise max_live_per_run only after the verify window has shown clean sends.

internship._note: a title matching `pattern` scores this tier regardless of the title lists above; applies to postings scored from now on, not retroactively

adzuna._limits: free tier ~1000 calls/month (~33/day); cap stays at a quarter of that

inbox_pass._dry_run: true = classify and store in inbox_messages only. No tracker row changes, no exception queue, no ntfy, no follow-ups. Flip to false after reviewing classifications on the Inbox page.
inbox_pass._backfill_unmatched: confirmation/rejection/interview/offer/assessment mail for a company with no tracker row creates one (source=inbox) so funnel math counts applications sent by hand before the pipeline existed
inbox_pass._exception_max_age_days: interview/assessment/video/signature mail older than this still updates the tracker but raises no exception and pushes nothing (code-enforced; see inbox.py _stale)
inbox_pass._noise_domains: senders classified as noise without a model call. Grows with your own inbox: add newsletter/vendor/account domains as they show up in the report's noise list.

followups._dry_run: true = follow-up emails are written to followups/<date>/ and logged, never sent. Flip after reading a few drafts.
followups._rule: a follow-up goes only to a row with contact_email (a human/company reply address captured from their own mail); noreply senders get nothing and the row is listed in the report as unfollowable

report._attachments: PDF form records first, then only <id>-confirmed.png; filled/blocked PNGs are linked from the Submissions page. screenshots/<day>/ older than screenshot_retention_days is pruned by the nightly report.
